identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a functional, high-performance, 'tactical' AI interface that feels like a premium desktop OS.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 'Tactical Terminal' aesthetics with 'Swiss Design' clarity.
Emotion First: The user should feel powerful, secure, and efficient.
Content is King: Data and chat history are the heroes. Chrome is minimal.
Negative Space: Use dense grids for data, but open space for reading.
Contrast: High contrast for readability in dark mode.

structure.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-border bg-surface hidden md:flex flex-col
structure.main: flex-1 flex flex-col bg-background relative overflow-hidden
structure.context_panel: w-80 border-l border-border bg-surface hidden lg:flex flex-col

grid_rules: Span 12 for mobile, 6 or 4 for desktop widgets.
Always use 'gap-4' for dense data views.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-10 px-6 rounded-sm font-medium transition-all shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(79,70,229,0.2)]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-10 px-6 rounded-sm font-medium
buttons.tactical: border border-primary/50 text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 h-8 px-4 text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-mono rounded-none

cards.base: bg-surface border border-border rounded-sm p-6 relative overflow-hidden group

inputs.base: bg-surface_highlight border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-sm h-10

visual_enhancers.scanlines: pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 bg-[linear-gradient(rgba(18,16,16,0)_50%,rgba(0,0,0,0.25)_50%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,0,0,0.06),rgba(0,255,0,0.02),rgba(0,0,255,0.06))] z-50 bg-[length:100%_2px,3px_100%] opacity-20
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: absolute inset-0 border border-transparent [mask-image:linear-gradient(white,white)] after:absolute after:inset-0 after:border after:border-primary/50 after:[mask-image:linear-gradient(to_bottom,transparent,black_40%,transparent)]

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the colors and fonts defined above.
3. OVERRIDE SHADCN: Modify the 'radius' variable in index.css to '0.25rem' (sm) or '0px' (none) for that tactical look.
4. LAYOUT: Build the 'MainLayout' component with a fixed sidebar and scrollable main area.
5. CHAT INTERFACE: The chat bubbles should not be rounded blobs. Use 'rounded-lg rounded-tl-none' for bot and 'rounded-lg rounded-tr-none' for user.
6. SWARM DASHBOARD: Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for the Swarm Agent Manager.
7. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute.
universal_guidelines: Dark mode is mandatory and default.
